home_p_35: We check your eligibility for funding assistance to build a safe room, and consolidate the entire process in one place — from the eligibility check and application submission, through planning and adaptation to the permit-exempt track, all the way to construction and handover.
home_p_36: Eligibility checks, government funding, registration, documents, and coordination with all parties — it's a lot of details, but you don't have to handle it alone. We consolidate the entire process for you under one roof.
home_p_37: We'll check your eligibility and find the most beneficial track for you.
home_p_38: We'll identify the sticking point, sort out the documents, and lead the process forward again.
home_p_39: We'll guide you through the planning stages, adapting the property to the permit-exempt track, and the construction all the way to handover.
home_p_40: Leave three details and our team will get back to you to continue the process.
home_p_41: The eligibility check is free of charge, and your details will only be used to contact you.
home_p_42: The check is conducted by a private company. Eligibility approval and funding are subject to the relevant authorized authorities.
home_p_43: We consolidate all stages of the process for you in one place, so you always know who to turn to and what the next step is. The ממ״ד הצפון team guides you hand in hand, from the initial registration to receiving the key.
home_p_45: We'll check your eligibility for funding assistance to build a safe room against the latest criteria, at no cost and with no obligation.
home_p_47: We handle all the bureaucracy: filling out the forms, attaching the required documents, and submitting the application to the authorized authorities.
home_p_49: We plan the safe room fully tailored to your needs and the structure of your home, while ensuring optimal use of space and budget.
home_p_51: An experienced execution team builds the safe room to the highest standard, with close supervision and quality control until key handover.
home_p_52: Throughout the entire process, you know exactly who is handling your case.
home_p_53: The exact scope of work and commitments are detailed in the proposal and agreement. Any documents or signatures required from you will be coordinated in advance during the process.
home_p_54: How does it work? Your path to a safe room, step by step
home_p_55:
A free eligibility check is just the beginning. ממ״ד הצפון guides you every step of the way
from initial registration to handover. Every stage is clear, documented, and handled by us.
home_p_56: Fill in your name, phone number, and locality. Our team will perform an initial eligibility check for state-funded safe room financing, at no cost and with no obligation.
home_p_57: We will get back to you for an introductory call, understand your property's situation and your needs, and consolidate all initial inquiries with the authorities in one place.
home_p_58: After assessing the property's suitability, we will proceed to a price proposal, engineering design, and obtaining Home Front Command approval before construction begins, within the permit-exempt track and subject to its conditions.
home_p_59: Completion of the safe room through to key handover according to the approved plan, and completion of the inspections, approvals, and reports required at the end of construction.
home_p_60: The first step: a free eligibility check
home_p_61: *The actual sequence of steps may vary depending on the status of the application and property conditions. Our team will keep you updated at every stage.
home_p_62: Every safe room project we undertake is made up of people, precise planning, and on-site execution. Here you can see the faces behind the guidance, the stages of construction, and the final result — real work, documented and transparent.
home_p_63: We present only work carried out by us or under our full responsibility, with an accurate description of our role. Before and after photos always belong to the same project.
home_p_65: Construction of an apartment-adjacent safe room including concrete casting, installation of a blast door, reinforced window, and air filtration system.
home_p_67: Full guidance in adapting the property to the permit-exempt track, preparation of architectural and structural plans, and handling Home Front Command approval.
home_p_69: Handover of a completed safe room including sealing tests, fixture installation, and full client walkthrough.
home_p_70: Before work begins, after reviewing the property details and the required work, you will receive a clear and organized price proposal. The proposal includes the scope of work, costs, and progress milestones, so you can make informed decisions with complete peace of mind.
home_p_71: Full details of all construction stages, materials, property adaptation to the permit-exempt track, and close guidance. Everything required for the safe room to be ready for handover is defined in advance and unambiguously.
home_p_72: Items not included in the basic scope, such as special finishes or custom modifications, will be presented separately with a clear cost. This way there are no surprises down the road.
home_p_73: The proposal includes an expected timeline, organized payment terms, and clear milestones. All agreements are documented in writing, so both parties know exactly what is happening at every stage.
home_p_74: The first step is always free. We check your eligibility for state funding assistance with no obligation whatsoever.
home_p_75: Planning services, property adaptation to the permit-exempt track, construction, and ongoing guidance are priced transparently and clearly in the organized price proposal you will receive.
home_p_76: We have compiled answers to the most frequently asked questions about the eligibility check process, financing, and construction. If you didn't find the answer, we are here to talk.
home_p_77: Our team is available to guide you at every stage. Leave your details and we will get back to you with all the information needed to start the process.
home_p_78: Free safe room eligibility check — no obligation, no cost. You register, we handle the entire process.
home_p_79: Yes. The initial eligibility check and our guidance in submitting the application through the government personal portal are provided free of charge. We assist in locating the required property documents, including the existing building permit and plans from the building file, and in obtaining a land registry extract or appropriate rights certificate. Where fees are required to obtain documents, they are paid separately to the issuing authority. This is an initial stage for clarifying eligibility and submitting the application; eligibility approval is granted by the authorized body within the program.
home_p_80: Simply leave your full name, phone number, and property address. We will contact you and guide you through collecting the documents and submitting the application. If you already have relevant documents, you can send them to us to advance the review.
home_p_81: Yes. We will check what stage you are at and can proceed to a price proposal for engineering design and construction of the safe room through to key handover. The service offered is carried out under the permit-exempt track, subject to compliance with the track's conditions and applicable regulations. It includes handling the planning approval with the Home Front Command before work begins, as well as the documents and reports required upon completion of construction with the Home Front Command and the local licensing authority. The service does not include the process of obtaining a building permit from the local planning committee.
home_p_82: No. Leaving your details and submitting an application do not guarantee receipt of funding. Eligibility approval and the grant amount are determined by the authorized body within the program, in accordance with the required conditions and documents.
home_p_83: Yes. After the initial stage, it is possible to proceed to a price proposal for professional and engineering design and construction of the safe room through to key handover. The service is offered under the permit-exempt track, subject to property suitability and track conditions, and includes handling Home Front Command approval and end-of-construction requirements.
home_p_84: Under the self-implementation track of the Magen HaTzafon program, the grant for eligible recipients may reach up to 182,000 NIS, subject to eligibility approval, the date of approval, and the program's conditions. The grant is paid according to established milestones. For deadlines and changes to the grant amount, see the question "Until when can an eligibility application be submitted?".
home_p_85: According to the current framework, the possibility of receiving eligibility under the self-implementation track for localities 1–9 km away ends at the end of 2028. For those whose eligibility is approved by 31.12.2027, the grant may reach up to 182,000 NIS; for those whose eligibility is approved during 2028, up to 132,000 NIS. From 2029, the track is closed to new eligibilities. It is therefore advisable to submit the application early: opening an application alone does not guarantee the grant amount. Deadlines are subject to official changes in the program.
home_p_86: A basic safe room can be planned at a net area of 9 sqm, or an expanded safe room at a total net area of up to 15 sqm in accordance with Amendment 163 to the Planning and Building Law: up to 12 sqm for the safe room and up to an additional 3 sqm for a bathroom and/or washroom. Expanding the room beyond 9 sqm within the amendment's addition is contingent on the addition of a bathroom or washroom.
home_p_87: The size and layout are determined according to the property's conditions, applicable regulations, and Home Front Command approval. Execution under the permit-exempt track is contingent on compliance with the track's conditions.
home_p_88: Our payment schedule is aligned with the milestones published by the state for receiving the grant, and subject to the program's conditions and the engagement agreement:
home_p_89: Leave your details for a free eligibility check for safe room construction funding assistance — our team will get back to you to continue the inquiry and guide you through to handover.
home_p_90: The check is free of charge and with no obligation.
home_p_91: Eligibility and funding approval are subject to the authorized bodies.
home_p_93: ממ״ד הצפון specializes in planning, property adaptation to the permit-exempt track, and construction of safe rooms and protected spaces in northern Israel. We guide you throughout the entire process — from eligibility check to key handover.
